modules/chaos_lite: Original stereo instability instrument; up to eight voices.
modules/chord: Turn each incoming note into a root plus up to four simultaneous semitone transpositions, preserving per-activation note ownership.
modules/cv_to_notes: Experimental polyphonic CV pitch and gate to paired note events.
modules/delay: Stereo delay with clock sync, a tone control and a limiter in the feedback loop, and ping-pong mode.
modules/gate_delay: Experimental 16-lane gate-edge and 1 kHz CV delay, with strum, seeded humanization and repeats.
modules/groove: Two synchronized 32-step tracks, pitch/gate/notes, two sample-and-hold modulation lanes, and queued transport
modules/macro_oscillator: Twenty-four-model oscillator; 48 kHz only, up to eight voices.
modules/mixer: Two mono audio inputs summed at independent Level A and Level B gains; unpatched inputs contribute silence.
modules/notes_to_cv: Polyphonic pitch, gate and velocity outputs from notes event streams with fresh voice allocation and source-aware note ownership.
modules/output: Mono graph output sink; opens no audio device.
modules/poly_merge: Experimental eight-mono-to-one-poly sample-accurate CV cable merger, highest-connected input sets lane count.
modules/poly_split: Experimental poly CV splitter with eight mono outputs. Missing channels output zero.
modules/quantizer: Quantizes pitch to the nearest note of a scale, with hysteresis, scale-step shift, optional sample-and-hold trigger and a trigger when the note changes.
modules/resonator: Three-comb polyphonic resonant body with deterministic internal strike exciter; eight active voices.
modules/reverb: Original eight-line stereo FDN reverb with freeze.
modules/scale_offset: Control output equals control input times Scale plus Offset; an unpatched input is zero.
modules/slew: Linear rise and fall slew limiter
modules/spectral: Two-source STFT processes: morph, cross-synthesis, max, mean, min, A minus B, interleave, vocoder.
sdk/examples/random_source: Clocked sample and hold of random values with a smoothed twin output
sdk/examples/step_sequencer: Sixteen-step pitch, gate and velocity sequencer with note events
